articles.headline_english: Flood compensation should be provided immediately
articles.english_headline: Flood compensation should be provided immediately
articles.content_english:
The Kerala Farmers' Association state conference demanded in the resolution that compensation should be provided immediately for the damages caused in the agricultural sector due to the natural disasters and floods that occurred in the months of July and August. The compensation for all agricultural crops and perennial crop losses should be assessed, and the compensation amount should be increased from the current rate and provided immediately, especially for those who have completely lost their homes.

New permits should be granted by including them in the scheme. Funds should be provided for repair work where there is partial damage. Adequate compensation should be given to small traders. Apply pressure at the center to get assistance for compensation.

The conference raised demands such as providing subsidy to dairy farmers who lost calves. According to official records, the state suffered a crop loss worth Rs 127.61 crore due to the rain damage. Most of this is loss. Crops were damaged on 9,332 hectares. This directly affected 45,904 farmer families. The Chief Minister said that compensation will be categorized at 2 percent.

It was announced that families taking refuge in the relief camps will receive Rs 10,000 each, and traders who lost their livelihood due to water entering establishments will receive Rs 10,929 each as financial assistance. The meeting pointed out that these benefits have not reached the disaster-affected people.

ജൂലൈ, ആഗസ്ത്‌ മാസങ്ങളി ലുണ്ടായ പ്രകൂൃതികേഷ്പോഭവും പ്രളയവുംമൂലം കാര്‍ഷിക മേഖ ലയിലുണ്ടായ നാശനഷ്ടങ്ങള്‍ ക്ക്‌ ഉടന്‍ നഷ്ടപരിഹാരം നല്‍ കരണമെന്ന്‌ കേരള കര്‍ഷകസം, ഘം സംസ്ഥാന സമ്മേളനം പ്രമേയത്തില്‍ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടു വി വിധ കാര്‍ഷിക വിള, കന്നുകാലി നാശം തിട്ടപ്പെടുത്തി നഷ്ടപരി ഹാര തുക നിലവിലെ നിരക്കില്‍ നിന്ന്‌ വര്‍ധിപ്പിച്ച്‌ ഉടന്‍ കൊടു ക്കണം,
പൂര്‍ണമായും വീട്‌ നഷ്ടപ്പെ ട്ൂവര്‍ക്ക്‌ ലൈഫ്‌ പദ്ധതിയില്‍ ഉള്‍

articles.content_english:
The state farmers' organization conference demanded to the central government to cancel free trade agreements, including the India-US agreement, the European Union agreement, and the India-New Zealand agreement, which adversely affect farmers, said Dr.

According to the Commission chaired by M. S. Swaminathan, the Parliament should enact legislation to fix a minimum support price for agricultural products, including the production cost and its percentage.

The 7th Food Safety Amendment Bill, Seed Bill, Electricity Privatization Bill, etc., should reinstate the employment guarantee scheme. Free trade agreements will strengthen the exploitation of Indian agriculture by monopolies. Not a single provision in these agreements protects the agricultural sector. Our agricultural production will see a massive increase in imports.

This will be a reason for the devaluation of our products. In 2025, the new seed bill will help agribusiness companies. The bill to privatize electricity will adversely affect the agricultural sector.

articles.content_english:
The Kerala Farmers' Association, at its state conference, demanded that measures should be taken to protect farmers and crops from wildlife attacks in Alapuzha. For this, the central government should make the necessary amendments to the Wild Life Protection Act of 1922. The government and local self-government institutions should take swift action to kill wild boars that destroy crops.

To prevent elephants and other wild animals from entering villages, protective walls, trenches, solar fences, rail fences, etc., should be constructed along forest boundaries. Surveillance cameras should be installed. Compensation for damage from wild animal attacks should be increased. Compensation for crop damage should also be increased.

articles.english_headline: The dismissal of the MILMA union is anti-democratic
articles.content_english:
Without consulting the Milma Federation and without even giving a notice as per the Cooperative Act, the Milma administrative committee, the largest cooperative institution operating in the dairy sector in Kerala, was unilaterally removed by the government. This action was taken after the Thiruvananthapuram (Meghla Union was removed).

The institution operating most effectively in the agricultural sector has taken actions that have greatly surprised the farmers. It is a public sector institution that operates profitably. The functioning of the institution will be disrupted due to the governing committee being dissolved with a narrow political motive.

The conference stated that the UDF government's decision to arbitrarily dissolve a committee that was elected democratically is completely illegal.

In Kozhikode, it is presented in some floating theaters. The play depicts the torture of theater-social activist Snehalatha Reddi, who was killed by the authoritarian terror of the Adi administration.
articles.content_english:
Snehalata was arrested on May 2, 197, under the preventive regulations for protesting against the emergency. Subsequently, she was subjected to severe torture in Bangalore Central Jail. After her health deteriorated, she was paroled on January 19, 1927, but she died on the fifth day. The journey of the play is traced through the diary notes written by Snehalata Reddy.

The question that the play 'Mis' raises is whether the state of emergency really ended when bulldozers, arriving as the voice of fascism in modern times, destroy homes and dreams.

articles.content_original:
അടിയന്തരാവസ്ഥക്കെതിരെ പ്രതിക. രിച്ചതിന്റെ പേരില്‍ 197 മെയ്‌ രണ്ടിനാണ്‌ സ്നേഹലതയെ മിസ കരിനിയമപ്രകാരം അറസ്റ്റ്‌ ചെയ്തത്‌. തുടര്‍ന്ന്‌ ബംഗളൂരു സെന്‍ട്രല്‍ ജയിലില്‍ കൊടും പീഡന ത്തിനിരയാക്കി. ആരോഗ്യംതകര്‍ന്ന അവരെ 1927 ജനുവരി 19ന്‌ പരോളില്‍ വി ടടങ്കിലും അഞ്ചാംദിവസം മരിച്ചു
സ്നേഹലത റെഡി എഴുതിയ ഡയറിക്കുറിപ്പുകളിലൂടെയാണ്‌ നാടകത്തി ന്റെ സഞ്ചാരം. പുതിയകാലത്ത്‌ ഫാസിസത്തിന്റെ ശബ്ദമായി എത്തുന്ന ബു ള്‍ഡോസറുകള്‍ വീടുകളും സ്വപ്നങ്ങളും തകര്‍ക്കുമ്പോള്‍ അടിയന്തരാവസ്ഥ ശരിക്കും അവസാനിച്ചോ എന്ന ചോദ്യമാണ്‌ മിസ നാടകം ഉയര്‍ത്തുന്നത്‌.

അടിയന്തരാവസ്ഥക്കെതിരെ പ്രതിക. രിച്ചതിന്റെ പേരില്‍ 197 മെയ്‌ രണ്ടിനാണ്‌ സ്നേഹലതയെ മിസ കരിനിയമപ്രകാരം അറസ്റ്റ്‌ ചെയ്തത്‌. തുടര്‍ന്ന്‌ ബംഗളൂരു സെന്‍ട്രല്‍ ജയിലില്‍ കൊടും പീഡന ത്തിനിരയാക്കി. ആരോഗ്യംതകര്‍ന്ന അവരെ 1927 ജനുവരി 19ന്‌ പരോളില്‍ വി ടടങ്കിലും അഞ്ചാംദിവസം മരിച്ചു

articles.english_headline: The violent history of Veeratelamana with the Sangh Parivar
articles.content_english:
The BJP and RSS are spreading the idea that the peasant struggle against Naisam's misrule and the fight of Muslims against oppressive rule is actually the fight of Hindus against Muslim rule. For this, they even made a film called 'Razzakar'.

Telangana's struggle or India's freedom struggle has nothing to do with it; RSS's election goal is to conduct false propaganda. Religion has no role in Telangana farmers' struggle against exploitation.

The tyrannical ruler Nizam and his armed forces, the Razakars, were alongside the landlord class who exploited farmers and workers, with the majority of landlords being Hindus. The Zamindars first killed a Muslim farmer named Bantaki.

പഞ്ചായത്ത്‌ അംഗമാണ്‌ ഹരിത ബൈജു, ആല ്ങാട്‌ ബ്ലോക്ക്‌ പഞ്ചായ ത്ത്‌ മുന്‍ പ്രസിഡന്റാണ്‌ രമ്യ തോമസ്‌. 24 ലോ ക്കല്‍ കമ്മിറ്റികളിലെ 320 വീടുകളിലാണ്‌ സമ്മേളന പ്രതിനിധികളായ 620 പേര്‍ക്കും താമസസൌക ര്യം. ലളിതയുടെ മരുമകള്‍ ജയ പ്രദിപ്‌ സിപിഐ എം ജില്ല സെക്രട്ടറിയാ യിരുന്ന കെ കെ കുമാര ന്റെയും രക്തസാക്ഷികെ വി ഷാജിയുടെയും കുടും ബാംഗമാണ്‌.
